# A projection carrying a law

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`projection-carrying-a-law` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](projection-carrying-a-law.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A projection carries a determined law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike; what the step does not depend on is re-absorbed in one step; a system changing its own rule has its law on the joint configuration.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Let P be a process on configurations with moves, and π a projection (description) of the configuration. P read through π, its image, has a step by a move from k to κ exactly where some step of P by that move goes from a configuration projecting to k to one projecting to κ; P's step factors through π into its image, and the image is the least process the step factors through. (`Becoming.Image`, `Becoming.factors_image`, `Becoming.Image.least`, `Becoming.FactorsThrough`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. Configurations alike under π go alike when any two configurations alike under π go by the same move to configurations alike under π. The image is determined, and some determined process on the description admits every step of P read through π, exactly where configurations alike go alike. (`Becoming.GoAlike`, `Becoming.image_determined_iff`, `Becoming.carries_law_iff`, `Becoming.Determined`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. Through the identity, going alike is determinacy; the description that distinguishes nothing always goes alike; a description of the image goes alike exactly where the composite description does. (`Becoming.goAlike_id_iff`, `Becoming.goAlike_const`, `Becoming.goAlike_image_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
4. Where configurations alike go alike, two runs with the same moves from configurations alike under π stay alike under π at every step. (`Becoming.GoAlike.runs_agree`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
5. Where the next configuration depends only on π, configurations alike go alike, and two runs with the same moves from configurations alike under π are equal from the first step on. (`Becoming.DependsOnlyOn`, `Becoming.DependsOnlyOn.goAlike`, `Becoming.DependsOnlyOn.reabsorbed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
6. A determined law depends only on π, as a process, exactly where configurations alike under π have the same next configuration, and then their orbits agree from the next step on. With the configuration read as state and rule, and the next configuration depending on the rule and not the state, two configurations with the same rule have the same orbit from the next step on. (`Becoming.Law.dependsOnlyOn_iff`, `Becoming.Law.reabsorbed`, `Becoming.Law.orbit`, `Becoming.Law.process`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
7. In a system changing its own rule, the state x under rule g becomes F g x u by move u and the rule becomes G g x; it is one determined process on the pair of state and rule. The state's projection goes alike, equivalently some determined process on the state admits every step read through the state, exactly where F agrees for every two rules at every state and move. (`Becoming.adaptive`, `Becoming.adaptive_determined`, `Becoming.adaptive_state_law_iff`, `Becoming.adaptive_state_carries_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
8. Along its runs, on a stretch where the rule stays g, the state's steps are steps of the determined law of g. (`Becoming.ruleLaw`, `Becoming.ruleLaw_determined`, `Becoming.Run.steps_by_rule`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. Read through a projection: where some determined process on the description admits the run's steps read through π before a step, the run has not taken a at a configuration projecting to k before it, and the description has two different elements, the record so read fixes no outcome of a at k; likewise where configurations alike go alike. (`Becoming.Run.TakesThrough`, `Becoming.Run.StepsThrough`, `Becoming.Run.FixesThrough`, `Becoming.Run.stepsThrough_retarget`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken`, `Becoming.Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike`, `Becoming.retarget`, `Becoming.retarget_determined`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
10. In Coarse the configuration is two bits, and each step flips the first and leaves the second free: the process is not determined, yet the first bit goes alike and the step factors through it into the determined law of flipping. (`Becoming.Coarse.process`, `Becoming.Coarse.not_determined`, `Becoming.Coarse.goAlike`, `Becoming.Coarse.carries`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
11. In Switching the state becomes the rule and the rule flips at every step: the joint process is determined, the state's projection does not go alike, and for the run from (false, false), for every t ≥ 2, no determined process on the state admits the run's steps up to t read through the state. (`Becoming.Switching.follow`, `Becoming.Switching.alternate`, `Becoming.Switching.process`, `Becoming.Switching.next`, `Becoming.Switching.run`, `Becoming.Switching.determined`, `Becoming.Switching.not_goAlike`, `Becoming.Switching.no_state_law`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations do not reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No premise: going alike (GoAlike) and depending only on (DependsOnlyOn) are properties characterized, not assumptions; carries_law_iff, image_determined_iff, goAlike_id_iff, goAlike_image_iff, Law.dependsOnlyOn_iff and adaptive_state_law_iff are two-way and hold of every process and every projection.
- A law is a determined process (Joint.Determined); carrying means the step factors through the projection into it (FactorsThrough, from Becoming.Experiment).
- Local conditions are written into the theorems: runs_agree and reabsorbed need the same moves and starts alike under π; Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken needs some determined process admitting the steps read through π, the move untaken, and two different elements of the description; Run.steps_by_rule needs the rule to stay over the stretch.
- The projection π and the reading as (state, rule) are supplied from outside the run; in adaptive the rule's update G does not depend on the move (as in the pasted θ′ = G(θ, x)).
- For the witnesses: the processes and runs of Coarse and Switching.
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; configurations, moves and descriptions of any type.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Does not show which projection an actual unfolding carries a law through, that any formation forms or uses a projection, or how a rule comes to change.
- A law means a determined process; structured undetermined laws and probabilities are not treated.
- Systems whose rule update depends on the move are not treated.
- The main theorems are near-definitional: what they add is the characterization and the least candidate.
- The reading of mechanism takes only the aspect “a law at a description” of the philosophy-of-science notion.
- The witnesses are minimal.
- **Counterexample:** A law at a coarser description and not at the whole: in Coarse each step flips the first bit and leaves the second free; the process is not determined, yet the first bit carries the determined law of flipping (Coarse.not_determined, Coarse.carries). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A law at the whole and not at a coarser description: in Switching the joint process is determined while the state has no law, and no determined process admits the first two steps of the run from (false, false) read through the state (Switching.determined, Switching.no_state_law). Together the two witnesses show that carrying a law is monotone neither toward coarser nor toward finer descriptions. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)
- **Counterexample:** That some description carries a law is no information: the description that distinguishes nothing carries one for every process (goAlike_const). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked “hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?”, pasted an explanation whose author is not stated (not Ren's wording, not a premise), asked “think for one more round, what can we learn, being inspired, and improve?”, and to the AI's five proposals answered “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the third proposal (a mechanism is a factoring, not a further kind of law). Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): a mechanism is a projection that carries a law, and the model of what is irrelevant (Becoming.Experiment) is characterized exactly by going alike; a projection of configuration is a third thing beside readings of time and finer units of amount; a law at a coarser description (emergence) is going alike there, and since the description that distinguishes nothing always carries one, the content lies in which description carries it; the rule holding the outcome (Becoming.Capture) is dependence on the rule only; a system that changes its own causality has its law on the joint configuration of state and rule, and needs no further kind of law; reading a model as a projection (Becoming.Experiment), this says when it carries a law: when it is a 理.
